title: A Robust Task-Level Control Architecture for Learned Dynamical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2511.09790v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dynamical system (DS)-based learning from demonstration (LfD) is a powerful tool for generating motion plans in the operation ('task') space of robotic systems. However, realizing generated motion plans is often compromised by a "task-execution mismatch", where unmodeled dynamics, persistent disturbances, and system latency cause the robot's task-space state to diverge from the desired state. We propose a novel task-level robust control architecture, L1-augmented Dynamical Systems (L1-DS), that explicitly handles the task-execution mismatch in tracking a nominal motion plan generated by any DS-based LfD scheme. Our framework augments any DS-based LfD model with a nominal stabilizing controller and an L1 adaptive controller. Furthermore, we introduce a windowed Dynamic Time Warping (DTW)-based target selector, which enables the nominal stabilizing controller to handle temporal misalignment for improved phase-consistent tracking.

translated_title: 一种用于学习动力系统的鲁棒任务级控制架构
translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.09790v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：基于动力系统（DS）的示范学习（LfD）是在机器人操作（'任务'）空间中生成运动计划的强大工具。然而，生成的运动计划的实现常常受到“任务-执行不匹配”的损害，其中未建模的动态、持续扰动和系统延迟导致机器人的任务空间状态偏离期望状态。我们提出了一种新颖的任务级鲁棒控制架构，即L1增强动力系统（L1-DS），该架构明确处理了跟踪由任何基于DS的LfD方案生成的标称运动计划时的任务-执行不匹配。我们的框架通过标称稳定控制器和L1自适应控制器增强了任何基于DS的LfD模型。此外，我们引入了一种基于窗口动态时间规整（DTW）的目标选择器，使标称稳定控制器能够处理时间不对齐，从而改进相位一致跟踪。
tldr: 本文提出了一种L1增强动力系统（L1-DS）控制架构，通过结合标称稳定控制器和L1自适应控制器，并利用基于窗口DTW的目标选择器，有效解决了机器人任务级运动计划中的任务-执行不匹配问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an L1-augmented Dynamical Systems (L1-DS) control architecture that combines a nominal stabilizing controller with an L1 adaptive controller and a windowed DTW-based target selector to effectively address task-execution mismatch in robotic task-level motion plan tracking.
